rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１５Um, well... There's something I￥want to say...
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１６"Awfully"? What's that supposed￥to mean? That really rubs me￥the wrong way!!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１７Creepy?! Did you just call￥me creepy?! And here I was...
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１８Ugh, that's the first time in￥my whole life anyone's ever￥said that to me!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１９You're always saying rude things￥to me, you know that?! You've￥been like this from the start!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０２０And on top of that, you keep￥seeing me at moments I'd rather￥nobody saw...
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０２３Then you can spare me a little￥of your time!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０２４That does it. I won't be￥satisfied until we settle￥this once and for all!!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０２７Hmph!￥With this, my record will top￥100 wins!!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０２９Listen, you! Getting to go up￥against me is a rare chance,￥you know!!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０３０If you turn me down, you'll￥regret it for the rest of￥your life!!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿００１Choosing flight training, my￥best event, might be a little￥unfair...
＊Riko＊＠１００＿００２But you're not good at anything,￥so it can't be helped.
＊Riko＊＠１００＿００５Well? Do you finally get￥how good I am?
＊Riko＊＠１００＿００６Took you long enough! I haven't￥been training since I was three￥for nothing, you know!!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿００７Ugh, sulking just because￥you lost.＝＠１００＿００８You shouldn't be such a sore￥loser!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿００９But... honestly, for a second￥I thought you'd catch me!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０１１Other than top-ranked active￥pilots, nobody's ever made me￥sweat like that...＝＠１００＿０１２You might be the first!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０１４When someone praises you, just￥be happy about it, okay?!＝＠１００＿０１５Honestly...
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０１６Hey!￥You're a million light-years￥away from beating me!＝＠１００＿０１７Honestly...
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０１８That was a good match...￥And I could tell how seriously￥you take being a candidate!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０１９To me, being a candidate was￥just something to brag about.
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０２０I didn't care at all about what￥would come after we got to￥Elan...＝＠１００＿０２１In that sense... the old me￥didn't even deserve to try to￥qualify.
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０２２But I think I understand now.＝＠１００＿０２３What an amazing thing it is to￥take the first step onto Elan as￥a representative of humanity.
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０２４I really, truly want to go now!!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０２５Yeah. I'm really glad I realized￥it before the final exam.
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０２６...Wait, why am I getting all￥sentimental with you of all￥people?!
＊Riko＊＠１００＿０２７O-oh, be quiet!￥It's not like it's thanks to￥you or anything!!＝＠１００＿０２８What does it matter anyway?!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿００１Listen! Just because I praised￥you a teeny bit, don't let it go￥to your head!!

＊Riko＊＠１０１＿００２You've still got a long￥way to go!!＝＠１０１＿００３Your landing timing is off, your￥turning angles are sloppy, your￥speed control is okay, but...＝＠１０１＿００４A-anyway, you've got plenty of￥weak spots!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿００５Oh, fine! Starting tomorrow,￥I'll teach you personally!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿００７So you really do want to￥go to Elan!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿００８There's no need to hold back￥with me!!
＊Riko＊＠１０１＿００９But!!￥I'm going to work you hard!￥Prepare yourself!!
